title: The Master Storybook — Chronology & Canon of Home Brew Tabletop Tools
scope: Original fictional universes indexed without false universe-merging

dateHierarchy: committed prose and authoritative series chronology

worlds.title: Elaranth · Concord of Crown and Commonwealth
worlds.summary: The same physical nation for Beneath Dappled Oaks, Rome and Daysha's royal chronicle, and the fantasy of Heroes of Embryon.

worlds.title: Embar-Zara · Castle Edselsto
worlds.summary: Luceran's reign and the Nowhere King prose series. Not the Elaranth/Rome throne.

worlds.title: Blacklight Continuum
worlds.summary: Charles and a team stranded aboard an Ar'nock derelict in a future mirror universe.

worlds.title: Kaysender · Homebrew campaign fiction
worlds.summary: Martiken's magical menagerie and the Lady of the Swamp; world-to-world links unconfirmed.

worlds.title: The Beckenburg Project
worlds.summary: Ghost-investigation game setting and Castle Beckenburg; no cross-realm relation asserted.

worlds.title: The Malefic Veil

worlds.title: Magenheim

works.title: Jewel Brook: Heroes of Embryon

works.title: Nowhere King · The Luceran / Edselsto prose

events.title: Delphimi settlement and the Sunder Compact

when.label: 0 S.M.

events.summary: The old tyrannical order falls; Crown and Commonwealth are joined into a divided constitutional state, and the Sunder Moon becomes the era's emblem.

events.title: Silver Night: west-tower deaths

when.label: Before the Last Seven's opening; exact calendar date unknown

events.summary: Thirty-six students and six servants die in a deliberate disaster. Ilyan knows his father and uncle were responsible; not an accident and not evidence of royal complicity.

events.title: Rome becomes king; Daysha already his queen

when.label: First regnal year · exact accession day unconfirmed (working 1 Thawcall 282 S.M.)

events.summary: Rome inherits the constitutional Moon-Crown system; the exact Avariel pedigree and legal accession route need reconciliation.

events.title: Beneath Dappled Oaks opens in Rome's first year

when.label: Halfway through Rome's first regnal year · working 14 Deepdelve, 282 S.M.

events.summary: Rome and Daysha are reigning spouses. Estelle has not been born. The Last Seven enter a court shadowed by Silver Night and institutional politics.

events.title: The Last Seven probe Silver Night's institutional record

when.label: Following opening, during Book One; individual chapters have separate causal order

events.summary: Witness screens, mnemonic plates, memory salt and conflicting written records become evidence, not instant proof that every suspect is guilty.

events.title: Chapter Thirty: lawful remedies versus interference records

when.label: After the earlier Last Seven investigations; exact day not fixed

events.summary: The lawful concentration review, Edrin Salver's administrative path and the interference record can be compared, without convicting Salver or proving every causal link.

events.title: Northern Felridge displacement and military inquiry

when.label: 282 S.M., date unassigned

events.summary: Unusual boar migration from the Felridge Forests prompts the Northern Orders and Midtrash Seventh Legion to investigate.

events.title: Daysha's Embryon identity and crystal adventures

when.label: Undated; specific missions not yet promoted to story canon

events.summary: Daysha is the Jewel Brook heroine in Elaranth; the in-game match-three and mining systems are not an event-by-event sovereign ledger.

events.title: Crystal Hollow and further named game-map proposals

when.label: Unplaced; game-art concepts only

events.summary: Aurelian Court, Crystal Hollow, Lumenwood, Shardsong Heights, Prismfall Observatory and Emberglass Depths lack verified in-universe map coordinates and dates.

events.title: Princess Estelle is born after the first regnal year

when.label: After Rome's first regnal year; birth date not established

events.summary: Estelle is unborn during all of Rome's first year. Her birth, later childhood and sixteenth birthday require their own independent child-age clock.

events.title: Princess Estelle's sixteenth birthday

when.label: Exactly sixteen years after her actual birth; civil/regnal year not set

events.summary: The royal-history long arc eventually reaches Estelle at sixteen; do not assume this happens during Rome's sixteenth regnal year.

events.title: Luceran inherits the Embar-Zara crown

when.label: Before Season 1's Edselsto move; local year unestablished

events.summary: After his parents' deaths, King Luceran inherits a legally valid but politically insecure monarchy.

events.title: Court returns to Castle Edselsto

when.label: Season 1, early

events.summary: The young king moves from the compromised capital to the decaying ancestral seat, unknowingly atop an ancient prison.

events.title: The first-season coup and Edselsto's awakening

when.label: Season 1 finale

events.summary: The coup fails, the castle opens its gates and becomes audibly, dangerously useful to its living monarch.

events.title: The eastern treasury and institutional custody conflict

when.label: Season 2 Episode 5

events.summary: Luceran's court uncovers the Eastern Household Reserve; the contents are not all Crown-owned, and lawful spending requires separating claims.

events.title: The castle's privacy and listening crises

when.label: Season 2, after treasury discovery

events.summary: Useful supernatural hearing prompts legal and personal boundaries, including the king's misuse of an intimate private conversation.

events.title: The seven candles fall and the final coalition fights

when.label: Seasons 3–5: planned macro arc, not all completed prose

events.summary: The geode prison and the original Nowhere King threaten Edselsto. Candle extinguishing and the final coalition are outline structure, not a completed historical ledger.

events.title: Charles deploys the Q-MAP team

when.label: Campaign prologue; far-future exact date unknown

events.summary: Charles sends operatives to a far-future mirror universe without ordinary Blacklight infrastructure or a verified return route.

events.title: Awakening aboard the Ar'nock derelict

when.label: Beginning of play, after Q-MAP deployment

events.summary: The team awakens in newly printed bodies aboard an Ar'nock vessel in the Gloam Concord; their capabilities come from explicitly established mechanics.

events.title: Martiken's Menagerie is in the setting

when.label: Undated source lore

events.summary: Martiken's mutable shop and transformation business are established campaign locations and services; no calendar event is inferred.

events.title: The Lady of the Swamp's covenant

when.label: Ongoing mythic/warlock tradition, no start year

events.summary: The patron's pact operates by Favor, Debt and negotiated service; no chronological link to Elaranth is established.

events.title: The Beckenburg supernatural investigation setting

when.label: No confirmed story date in master source audit

events.summary: Castle Beckenburg, ghost investigators and the game's campaign logic exist as independent fiction; story dates require game-source audit.

events.title: The Malefic Veil settlement era

when.label: Civil year and historical ordering not audited

events.summary: Factions Unraveled, Penitent and Begotten belong to this separate game world; no Elaranth correspondence is asserted.

events.title: Magenheim and its distinct Nowhere King

when.label: Local chronology not audited

events.summary: A Magenheim boss shares the name 'Nowhere King' but is not Luceran's imprisoned entity; source separation is mandatory.

events.title: The first noble-district purchase

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: Daysha's first non-wedding boutique visit: midnight-blue gown, followed by icy-blue gown.

events.title: Sunday: a pink gown

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: Daysha selects a much simpler light-pink gown. Rome realizes her affection for dresses will not be brief.

events.title: Second Friday: two more gowns

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: Burgundy gown and black-bodice/violet-starfield/white-panel gown; Rome blushes; Garrick is amused.

events.title: The royal procession of dress boxes

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: The couple depart The Gilded Spindle, Garrick consults his ledger, and servants carry boxed gowns.

events.title: Daysha's first birthday as queen and Lexi's arrival

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: A royal-blue-and-gold birthday gown is made under a deadline; a servant presents Lexi, the first appearance of the star-furred celestial Maine Coon.

events.title: The unfinished-gown double purchase

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: The Friday after the birthday, Daysha loves the unembellished powder-blue gown and insists on an adjacent unfinished white-and-pink dress.

events.title: A self-funded Sunday purchase

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: Daysha returns without Rome or Lexi and buys the royal-blue-and-gold gown using the royal purse.

events.title: Fine cloth without gemstones

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: A pearlescent enchanted scale gown and teal filigree offering teach the artisans that Daysha loves immaculate craft even when the cloth carries no gems.

events.title: The easy enchanted gown

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: A simpler midnight/periwinkle-blue gown with restrained filigree and long draped sleeves delights the queen and lightens the seamstresses' workload.

events.title: The visiting master seamstress

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: A seamstress from abroad prepares the spectacular ocean-themed gown; the atelier also offers black/teal gold-embroidered finery.

events.title: The Queen Mother's first appearance

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: Daysha and Rome's mother visit without Rome or Lexi. The Queen Mother insists on the suitability of a rich blue gemstone-adorned dress.

events.title: Daysha returns the gift

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: Daysha chooses a luxurious lavender and pink ballgown for her mother-in-law; uniquely, the supplied design is worn by the Queen Mother.

events.title: Matching gowns for two queens

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: The women shop without Rome or Lexi and wear the same design in blue-white for Daysha, brilliant red-white for the Queen Mother.

events.title: The star-lit gown and Rome's admiration

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: Later that weekend Daysha wears a starry deep-blue and icy-blue gown; Rome becomes adorably flustered.

events.title: The Queen Mother's birthday commission

when.label: After Rome's coronation; event sequence known, calendar year unknown

events.summary: Daysha commissions a light-blue royal event gown with a handful of special valuable stones, blending her love of fine simplicity and her mother-in-law's love of gems.

events.title: The royal jewel delivery chase

when.label: Future of Rome's first regnal year, after Estelle's birth; exact year and age unknown

events.summary: Daysha and daughter Estelle chase a jewel delivery later revealed to be intended for the Queen Mother.

events.title: Palace garden tea and royal daycare

when.label: Future of Rome's first regnal year, after Estelle's birth; exact year and age unknown

events.summary: The family shares pastries; Estelle visits royal daycare.

events.title: Estelle's glitter balloon prank

when.label: Future of Rome's first regnal year, after Estelle's birth; exact year and age unknown

events.summary: Estelle pelts Rome with a glitter-filled water balloon while ministers laugh; a corrected bursting-balloon illustration is approved.

events.title: Family catroom and magical cleanup

when.label: Future of Rome's first regnal year, after Estelle's birth; exact year and age unknown

events.summary: Rome is glitter-covered with two Maine Coons; Daysha magically cleans him before the family walks toward the courtyard.
